# Definition 
**5-alpha reductase deficiency** is a disorder of decreased 5-alpha reductase activity. 

# Pathophys 
Patients (XY) cannot convert T to DHT. 

At puberty, increased T causes virilization → nodulocystic acne, clitoromegaly $\pm$ voice deepening, increased muscle mass.

# Presentation 
- **undescended testes** → bilateral labial masses.
- no male external genitalia 
- phenotypically female appearance.
- no breast development (T binds breast androgen receptor and stops proliferation)

# Diagnosis 
Elevated T/DHT ratio
